record.what_it_does: SEO data platform: backlinks, keywords, SERPs, rank tracking, site audit, via API.
record.auth_notes: Direct API v3 calls send an API key in the "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" header. Only workspace owners and admins can create keys, and each key expires after 1 year. Third-party apps use Ahrefs Connect, which is OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE. The authorize URL is https://app.ahrefs.com/web/oauth/authorize, the token URL is https://ahrefs.com/oauth/token, and the scope is apiv3-integration-apps. Access tokens last 1 year and no refresh tokens are issued, so users must re-authorize when a token expires. Requests use the connecting user's own API units. The hosted MCP server also uses an OAuth consent flow that issues a dedicated API key. Some "public" endpoints are free and need no key.
record.access_notes: Joining Ahrefs Connect has no plan requirement. While an app is Inactive, the developer can make free test requests and test OAuth in staging. Going live needs Ahrefs approval: you notify support or sales, then submit for review, and the review includes showing secure token handling. The help center says API v3 is available on Lite and higher, and that "all new applications require a Lite or higher subscription for activation". Lite includes 200k units a month. I found no source for the first pass's Enterprise requirement, and the Connect pages I opened don't mention Enterprise. End users must have paid Ahrefs accounts, and their calls use their own units. Free test queries on direct API keys are limited to ahrefs.com, yep.com and firehose.com targets.
record.api_breadth_notes: REST at https://api.ahrefs.com/v3/{tool}/{endpoint}, split into 15 tool specs: Site Explorer, Competitive Analysis, Keywords Explorer, Site Audit, Rank Tracker, SERP Overview, Batch Analysis, Subscription Info, Management, Brand Radar, Content Helper, Web Analytics, GSC Insights, Social Media and Public. In the truncated views I could read, the Management spec showed 26 operations (CRUD on projects, keywords, keyword lists, competitors and Brand Radar prompts) and Site Explorer showed at least 14. The total is well over 50. The merged OpenAPI spec (3.2.0) is at https://docs.ahrefs.com/openapi.json.
record.mcp_notes: Official hosted MCP server at https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp (Streamable HTTP). It uses an OAuth consent screen, and you can also generate an MCP key manually. It is for Lite plans and higher. I did not re-check the first pass's claim that the old local repo is archived.
record.blocker_notes: Building is self-serve: Connect needs no plan, and inactive apps get free test requests. Shipping public OAuth to other users needs Ahrefs approval, and per the help center the app needs Lite or higher to activate. End users need paid Ahrefs plans and spend their own API units on every call (50-unit minimum per paid request). Tokens expire after a year with no refresh, so users must periodically re-authorize.
